sources: https://horsethiefreservoir.com/activities/camping/ (HorseThief Reservoir Benefit District), read 2026-11-05: 'HorseThief has 55 water/electric campsites and an unlimited amount of primitive sites. Handicap accessible shower house and restrooms are nearby. We do offer a sewer dump station as well. We recently added four utility campsites that have sewer hookups. These are rented to long term campers, but could possibly be up for rental during other times of the year. Reservations for utility sites are accepted and are recommended during summer months (May 1 - September 30) and summer holidays! ... October 1 through April 30, utility camping sites are on a first come, first serve basis. ... call the office at (620) 253-8464'; 'All campers and camping units are limited to a stay of not more than 14 consecutive days. Upon completing 14 consecutive days, each person and their property shall be absent from the campground of last use for not less than 5 days. One extended camping stay of not more than 14 additional consecutive days ... through a written permit issued by the Park Manager.'; 'DAILY VEHICLE = $5 or ANNUAL VEHICLE = $50; DAILY CAMPING $10.00; ANNUAL CAMPING $250.00; DAILY UTILITY FEE $15.00'; footer '-9 miles west of Jetmore, Kansas- Phone: (620)253-8464', '(c) Copyright 2022-'

https://horsethiefreservoir.com/regulations-and-fees/, read 2026-11-05: the same fee table; 'Reservations can be made in person, by phone, or online by visiting: https://campspot.com/book/horsethiefreservoir. All online reservations must be made two (2) days in advance.'; 'Camping reservations require payment in full at the time of booking.'; 'Canceling campsites or lodging units 8 days or more prior to arrival result in a refund less a $10.00 transaction fee. Cancellations within 7 days of arrival will not be refunded.'; 'Generators are prohibited in the Main Utility campground which shall include the gazebos.'; 'Fisherman SHALL not park in Campsite UNLESS payment for use of utility campsite has been paid at the office. (Fee $25)'

Campspot API for park 2294 'HorseThief Reservoir - Jetmore, KS' (https://www.campspot.com/book/horsethiefreservoir, through the browser driver), read 2026-11-05 for 2026-11-10, 2027-01-26 and 2027-06-08 with includeUnavailable: 15 site types, all lodging units (Modern Lodging $133.90, Primitive Lodging $83-103), an event pavilion, a gazebo, a lodge and storage - no RV or campsite type at all

Esri World Imagery at the stored pin 38.0568,-100.0605 (700 m and 220 m half), 2026-11-05: the pin is in open water of the reservoir. The camping loops are on the north shore: a cove loop centred ~38.0592,-100.0585 whose pull-in pads (about 15) sit on the lake side of the loop road ending ~10-30 m from the shoreline with only grass between pad and water, more pads across the road; further sites along the NW shore road and a western loop. OSM tags the camp_site at 38.0590,-100.0593.

values.note: Utility (water/electric) site: daily camping $10 plus daily utility fee $15; primitive camping $10. A $5 daily vehicle permit ($50 annual) is required too. Annual camping $250.

values.note: Utility sites are reservable (recommended) May 1 to September 30 and on summer holidays, by phone (620) 253-8464 or in person; October 1 to April 30 they are first come, first served. The Campspot engine the site links sells only the lodging units, not campsites. Payment in full at booking; cancel 8+ days out for a refund less $10. One 14-day extension by the manager's written permit, otherwise 5 days away after 14.

note: HorseThief Reservoir Benefit District lake ~9 mi west of Jetmore, with a swim beach, boat launch, disc golf, trails (horses on the south side only) and rentable lodging units. The north-shore cove loop's pull-in pads back onto the water; unlimited primitive camping besides. Generators are not allowed in the main utility campground. --Claude
summary: District pages: 55 water/electric sites, unlimited primitive, showers + dump, $10 camping + $15 utility = $25 (+$5 daily vehicle permit), 14-day max, reservable by phone May-Sep, FCFS Oct-Apr, year-round. Changed sewer true (derived) -> cleared (sewer only at 4 long-term sites); added count 55, season, booking platform/season/max stay, entrance fee. Pin was in the lake: moved ~340 m to the north-shore cove loop. Lakefront kept (imagery: lake-side pull-in pads).
flags: PIN MOVED: stored 38.0568,-100.0605 is in open water of the reservoir; the campground's main cove loop is at 38.0592,-100.0585 (~340 m NNE; OSM camp_site 38.0590,-100.0593). The waterfront_evidence, if it was read at the stored pin, was read in the lake.

WATERFRONT lakefront kept, now with imagery evidence: on the north-shore cove loop ~15 pull-in pads lie on the lake side of the loop road, each ending ~10-30 m from the shoreline with only grass between pad and water (no day use or driveway between); the pads across the road are lakeview only. Reservoir is several hundred acres.

BOOKING: the site says reservations can be made online at Campspot, but Campspot's park 2294 lists only lodging units, a pavilion, a gazebo, a lodge and storage - no RV/campsite type on any date read. So RV sites book by phone or in person (platform phone). booking.url not written.

HOOKUPS: sewer true (derived) cleared: the only sewer sites are four 'rented to long term campers, but could possibly be up for rental during other times'. Electric 50 (derived) left - the district's pages don't give amps.

FEES: $25 = $10 daily camping + $15 daily utility, plus the $5 daily vehicle permit, recorded as fees.entrance. Fee pages carry no year; live pages, footer '(c) 2022-'. Price gate doesn't apply (local).
PHONE (620) 253-8464 matches. WEBSITE https://horsethiefreservoir.com is the district's own. Ownership local (HorseThief Reservoir Benefit District) correct. SAND: none.
